title: BoJ-Policy Stance Indicator (Free edition)

standfirst: Where every seat on the Bank of Japan's policy board sits on Economy, Inflation and the Policy Rate, scored from the Bank's own published communications. A board map with a meeting slider, the scores at each meeting, and one chart per member. This is the free edition, frozen at the April 2026 meeting; the paid edition carries every meeting since.
